merge_cfg_from_file: merge a YAML config file into the global Detectron config to override default options
merge_cfg_from_list: merge command line config key value pairs into the global Detectron config
assert_and_infer_cfg: assert and infer inferred config values then mark the global config as immutable
get_output_dir: get the output directory path for training or testing based on datasets and model type
cache_cfg_urls: download and cache model weight URLs locally then rewrite the config to use cached paths
